nodes.description: An angle is measured with reference to a circle with its center at the common endpoint of the rays, by considering the fraction of the circular arc between the points where the two rays intersect the circle. edges.reason: Degree measure prepares a more precise description of how far a shape turns. The actual criteria only require invariance and clockwise/counterclockwise direction, so protractor measurement is not necessary.
Translation introduces size and shape invariance under a motion. Observing a clock hand or turning a cutout establishes rotation invariance and direction independently of grid translation.
edges.scope: size and shape invariance under motion
